units.source_text: 这不应是我这样做的场合，可我面对玻璃橱内的金阁却看得入了迷。

en.t: This was not the sort of occasion on which I should have been doing such a thing, but facing the Golden Pavilion inside the glass case, I found myself staring at it in fascination.

units.source_text: 这小小的金阁在火柴亮光的照耀下，摇曳着它的影子，使其纤细的木质结构充满不安，显得卑躬屈膝。

en.t: Illuminated by the light of the match, this tiny Golden Pavilion swayed with its shadow, making its delicate wooden structure seem filled with unease and appear abjectly servile.

units.source_text: 这种景象又被黑暗吞噬了。

en.t: Then this sight was swallowed up by darkness again.
Because the match had burned out.
